title: Exa Search Result
description: A single search result returned from the Exa /search endpoint. Captures the URL, title, author, published date, relevance score, optional text and highlights, and the Exa result identifier.

id.description: Stable Exa identifier for the result, suitable for use with /contents and /findSimilar.

author.description: Detected author of the page, when available.

score.description: Relevance score assigned by Exa, higher is more relevant.

text.description: Full or truncated page text when contents.text was requested.

highlights.description: Token-efficient highlight snippets selected by Exa to reduce LLM context usage by ~90%.

highlightScores.description: Per-highlight relevance scores aligned with the highlights array.

summary.description: Optional Exa-generated summary of the page contents.

image.description: Hero image URL detected for the result.

favicon.description: Favicon URL detected for the result's domain.

subpages.description: Subpages returned when contents.subpages was requested.
